FN-PS6HJRE-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 277
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Shay Shelnutt
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/09/2025
Senate Bill 277 as introduced could increase the expenditures of local boards of education and
the State Department of Education by an undetermined amount dependent upon the cost to
implement the changes to sex education curriculum required by this bill.
